Diego Vega: Hi team! Diego here — starting today as an Infrastructure Eng on Platform. PST based; excited to dig into the serving runtime. First week goals: get laptop and MDM, VPN access, and shadow a deploy. Quick questions: 1) Is there an expected delivery ETA for my MacBook? 2) Who handles VPN certs and badge access? 3) Any "must-watch" docs or meetings? Fun fact: I ferment hot sauce and ride a fixed-gear bike on weekends :hot_pepper: :bike:

People Ops - Emily: Welcome Diego!! :tada: Equipment request is submitted, ETA usually 2-4 business days. You should be auto-added to #new-hires and the orientation on Fri @10am PT. For badge and building access I've started a request; I'll update here when it's approved. If you need faster access, DM me.

Sam W.: Yo Diego — glad you're here. I'll schedule a 30m intro tomorrow to run through the infra playbooks. Platform standup Tue 10:30 PT, infra sync Thu 11 PT. No need to join everything yet.

Sarah D.: Hi @Diego Vega — for MDM/VPN: once the laptop arrives, enroll via the Device Enrollment link in the email. If you want CLI steps: ```brew install redwood-dev-tools; rwd login; rwd enroll``` If you hit a permissions prompt, ping me and I can remote in.

Ravi K.: Added you to platform repos and internal docs. I can request temporary KMS read for initial testing if you tell me which buckets you need. Also sent the GitHub invite.

onboarding-bot: Equipment ticket TICKET-20234 created. ETA: 3 business days. Orientation event added: "New Hire Orientation — Fri 10:00 PT". Helpful links: Handbook, IT Help.

Diego Vega: Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. I'll wait for the laptop and try the CLI once it's up. Sam — virtual coffee sounds great. Also if anyone has taco recs in SF, send them my way :taco:

Sam W.: taco crawl next week? :grin:

People Ops - Emily: Welcome again! :wave:

Sarah D.: If enrollment fails, DM me and I'll hop on a quick remote session. :thumbsup:

Ravi K.: Welcome Diego! Looking forward to pairing on a serving-run shadow.
